name: Do I need a TBI attorney if I already have health insurance?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a TBI attorney if I already have health insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, even if you have health insurance, a TBI attorney is crucial. Health insurance typically covers medical treatment but does not account for all the damages associated with a TBI, such as lost wages, future medical care not covered by insurance, long-term rehabilitation costs, pain and suffering, or reduced quality of life. An attorney helps you recover these non-medical expenses and ensures your health insurer's subrogation claims are handled appropriately, maximizing your overall compensation and protecting your financial future.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a TBI attorney helps recover damages beyond medical treatment, such as lost wages, future care, and pain and suffering, even if you have health insurance.
